description: Self-contained ON PURPOSE. The devfellowship fleet extends github>devfellowship/dfl-hq:renovate-config, but dfl-hq is a PRIVATE repo in a DIFFERENT org: a Renovate installation on iterahq holds an iterahq token and cannot read it, so that preset fails to resolve here. The rules below are the parts of the fleet config that apply to this repo, inlined.

packageRules.description: Fleet default: CI-green non-major bumps land on their own.
Majors wait for a human, with a longer stabilisation window.
@iterahq/* is FIRST-PARTY and moves several times a day (0.12.1 -> 0.14.0 -> 0.15.0 in one afternoon, 2026-08-10), so the 7-day window would make every bump a week late. No stabilisation wait.

@iterahq/activity-spec does NOT auto-merge, even when green. Measured on 2026-08-10: two consecutive rounds produced bumps whose test suites passed untouched while real behaviour moved. In itera-mcp the green bump left stale SPEC_LAYERS rows holding keys OUT of the write-gate parse; in itera-backoffice it silently added a new block to the activity editor. A green suite is evidence that nothing KNOWN broke, not that nothing changed - and while this package is pre-1.0 its minors carry tightenings (.strict(), the class assert change that broke itera-player's build on 0.13.0). A human reads the diff.
